name: MobileQuestionBank
css: .mobile-question-bank-page{min-height:100vh;background:#f5f7fa;font-family:'PingFang SC','Microsoft YaHei','Noto Sans SC',sans-serif;display:flex;flex-direction:column}.top-nav{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;height:56px;padding:0 16px;background:#ffffff;border-bottom:1px solid #f0f2f5;position:sticky;top:0;z-index:100}.nav-left,.nav-right{width:40px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center}.nav-back,.nav-icon{cursor:pointer;transition:opacity 0.2s}.nav-back:hover,.nav-icon:hover{opacity:0.7}.nav-title{font-size:18px;font-weight:700;color:#1A365D;margin:0}.search-bar{padding:12px 16px;background:#ffffff;border-bottom:1px solid #f0f2f5}.search-input-wrapper{display:flex;align-items:center;background:#f5f7fa;border:1px solid #e8ecf1;border-radius:8px;padding:0 12px}.search-input-wrapper input{flex:1;border:none;background:transparent;padding:10px 8px;font-size:14px;color:#1a2b5f;outline:none}.clear-btn{cursor:pointer}.main-content{flex:1;padding:16px;overflow-y:auto;padding-bottom:80px}.top-actions{margin-bottom:16px}.action-scroll{display:flex;gap:12px;overflow-x:auto;padding-bottom:8px;-webkit-overflow-scrolling:touch}.action-btn{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:12px 16px;background:#ffffff;border:1px solid #e8ecf1;border-radius:12px;cursor:pointer;transition:all 0.3s ease;white-space:nowrap;box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(26,54,95,0.04)}.action-btn.active{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#1A365D 0%,#2a5298 100%);border-color:#1A365D;color:#ffffff}.action-btn:hover:not(.active){border-color:#1A365D}.action-name{font-size:14px;font-weight:600}.action-tag{font-size:10px;background:#c41e3a;color:#ffffff;padding:2px 6px;border-radius:4px;font-weight:600}.category-filter{margin-bottom:16px}.category-scroll{display:flex;gap:8px;overflow-x:auto;padding-bottom:8px;-webkit-overflow-scrolling:touch}.category-chip{padding:8px 16px;background:#ffffff;border:1px solid #e8ecf1;border-radius:20px;font-size:13px;color:#5a6488;cursor:pointer;transition:all 0.3s ease;white-space:nowrap}.category-chip.active{background:#1A365D;border-color:#1A365D;color:#ffffff}.category-chip:hover:not(.active){border-color:#1A365D;color:#1A365D}.question-list{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:12px}.question-card{background:#ffffff;border-radius:12px;padding:16px;box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(26,54,95,0.04);cursor:pointer;transition:all 0.3s ease}.question-card:hover{box-shadow:0 4px 16px rgba(26,54,95,0.1);transform:translateY(-2px)}.question-header{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;margin-bottom:12px}.question-type{padding:4px 10px;border-radius:6px;font-size:12px;font-weight:600}.question-difficulty{display:flex;gap:2px}.question-title{font-size:16px;font-weight:600;color:#1a2b5f;margin:0 0 12px;line-height:1.4}.question-meta{display:flex;gap:16px;margin-bottom:12px}.meta-item{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:4px;font-size:12px;color:#8899aa}.question-tags{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap}.tag{padding:4px 10px;background:#f5f7fa;border-radius:4px;font-size:11px;color:#5a6488}.empty-state{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:60px 20px;text-align:center}.empty-state p{font-size:14px;color:#8899aa;margin:16px 0 0}.bottom-tab-bar{position:fixed;bottom:0;left:0;right:0;height:60px;background:#ffffff;display:flex;justify-content:space-around;align-items:center;border-top:1px solid #f0f2f5;padding-bottom:env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0);z-index:100}.tab-item{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;flex:1;height:100%;cursor:pointer;transition:all 0.2s}.tab-item.active{color:#1A365D}.tab-item:not(.active){color:#a0a4b8}.tab-label{font-size:10px;font-weight:500;margin-top:2px}@media(max-width:375px){.action-btn{padding:10px 12px}.action-name{font-size:13px}.question-title{font-size:15px}}
